title: 烫金局部不上金、缺金、转移不完整怎么办？

seo.title: 烫金局部不上金、缺金、转移不完整怎么办？

content:
## 内容定位

用于回答“为什么局部不上金？”“烫金缺金怎么办？”“转移不完整是膜的问题还是机器问题？”等故障排查内容。

## Reddit 英文短评版

Incomplete transfer can come from low temperature, insufficient pressure, rough substrate, uneven pressure or a foil release that is too heavy.

I would not change everything at once. First test a small temperature increase, then check pressure balance. Also test fine text and a solid block separately. If the solid area is patchy, it may be pressure or substrate smoothness. If fine lines are broken, it may be release or temperature.

## PrintPlanet 技术长评版

Incomplete foil transfer should be diagnosed by artwork type.

If the missing foil appears mainly in large solid areas, I would check substrate smoothness, pressure uniformity, die flatness and foil coverage capability. If the issue appears mainly in fine lines or small text, I would check release behavior, temperature, dwell time and die sharpness.

A useful test form should include:

1. Small text

1. Fine lines

1. Solid block

1. Reverse text

1. Actual customer logo

If the foil transfers well on fine text but not on solid areas, a large-area foil grade may be needed. If solid areas transfer but fine lines break, a cleaner-release fine-detail foil may be more suitable.

## 知乎中文科普版

局部不上金、缺金、转移不完整，通常可以从四个方向排查：

第一，温度是否偏低。温度不够时，胶层没有完全活化，金属层转移不完整。

第二，压力是否不足或不均匀。如果左右两边效果不同，可能是压力平衡或模具问题。

第三，底材是否太粗糙。牛皮纸、特种纸、纹理纸更容易出现缺金。

第四，膜的离型是否太重。离型太重，小字和细线容易转不下来。

测试时不要只看一个logo，最好同时测试小字、细线、大面积实地和反白字。这样才能判断问题到底来自膜、机器参数还是底材。

## 阿里国际站成交版

Incomplete transfer may be caused by low temperature, insufficient pressure, short dwell time, rough paper surface or unsuitable foil release.

To help you choose the right foil, please send us:

- Photos of the stamping defect

- Substrate type

- Machine type

- Current temperature

- Pressure and dwell time

- Artwork type: fine text, logo or solid area

We can recommend either a fine-detail foil or a solid-area foil depending on your artwork.

## 自然 CTA

A sample test on the real substrate would be more reliable than guessing by color.

## 关键词

incomplete foil transfer, missing foil, hot stamping defect, 烫金不上金, 烫金缺金, 烫金转移不完整, 烫金膜离型
